items.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
items.summary: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.

items.title: Nigeria’s central bank introduces stablecoin licensing rules, bans algorithmic versions
items.summary: Nigeria's central bank issued new virtual asset regulations requiring stablecoin issuers and other service providers to obtain local licenses.

items.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
items.summary: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

items.title: Base deploys Denim upgrade on mainnet, replacing Flashblocks with 200ms block times
items.summary: Base activated its fourth network upgrade, Denim, introducing five canonical blocks per second at 200ms intervals.

items.title: US Bank Regulator Issues First AI Framework as Banks Battle Rogue Agents
items.summary: The OCC's first examiner guide weighs autonomy and financial harm, and directly addresses outside AI agents—the same risk that recently prompted major banks to restrict customer-account access.
